structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Emphasize the exhilarating, persistence-driven experience of the Flight School ride while preserving the credibility of the photographed moment.
structured_intent.initial_state: Five excited riders are secured in wing-shaped seats at different orientations around a large articulated indoor ride, with the woman in pink nearly horizontal at the right.
structured_intent.primary_action: The camera approaches the visible woman in pink through the ride’s existing depth planes.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The woman in pink appears observably closer and more prominent while all five riders and the ride’s original pose remain visible and unchanged.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: All seats, wings, restraints, support arms, and the orange hub retain their rigid shapes, attachments, and current articulated topology.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: Exactly five visible riders remain the same people with unchanged bodies, clothing, limbs, seats, restraints, and ride components; nothing appears or disappears.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The riders remain safely secured and visibly excited throughout; the scene continues to convey controlled thrill rather than danger or mechanical failure.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The image proves rigid seat-to-arm attachments, secured riders, multiple depth planes, and an articulated ride pose. It does not prove the axis, direction, phase, or safe continuation of the mechanism, so a rotation or 360° arc would be invented; the visible depth supports a safe camera-only treatment.

scene_plan: Over five seconds, begin the forward camera move immediately and maintain a calm, even pace toward the rightmost woman in pink. Use the overlapping seats and support arms for source-grounded parallax while keeping the articulated ride and riders frozen in world space. Ease gently near the end when the focal rider is observably larger and the nearest machinery has shifted roughly 5–8% in screen space; preserve the original framing and visibility of all five riders.

prompt.positive: The camera steadily pushes toward the woman in pink while all five riders, restraints, wings, support arms, and the orange hub remain rigidly connected and source-locked. By the final frame she is clearly larger, with foreground machinery displaced about 5–8% of the frame and every rider still visible.
